markets._note: German averages roughly 10-35% longer than English. This is the single most common cause of layout breakage on resized variants. Confirm expansion factors with Typeface localisation data.

cultural_notes: 'Du' vs 'Sie' register decision must be brand-level and consistent

markets._note: Halo Grotesk has no CJK glyph coverage. Any JP variant using it will tofu or silently substitute. This is a hard blocker class that brand kits rarely encode.
cultural_notes: white space is a quality signal, do not fill

markets._note: RTL requires layout mirroring, not just translation. Logo placement, CTA position and image gaze direction all flip.
